about: Thresholds and defaults for the cockpit (./securax cockpit). Edit here; nothing is hard-coded elsewhere. Lower is better unless the name says free/pct/coverage.
profile_help: personal: open authentication/residency are shown as 'no data' (fine on one laptop). regulated: they are red. Override with SECURAX_PROFILE in local/compose/.env.
target_help: 0 non-existent, 1 initial, 2 acknowledged, 3 defined, 4 managed, 5 optimal (the scale of the NIST CSF maturity radar). 3.0 = 'defined'.
